Basketball Goal Removal in Spring

Old basketball goals, portable bases and in-ground poles are heavy and hard to move. We remove them completely, including concrete bases when needed.

Spring runs from the antique shops of Old Town Spring to large 1990s and 2000s subdivisions with two-car garages and big backyards, so we see everything from garage purges to backyard structures. Basketball Goal Removal jobs here often come alongside garage and storage cleanouts, trampoline and playset teardowns, post-move leftovers, and furniture or appliance pickups in the subdivisions off Louetta and Spring Cypress.

What this covers

  • ✓Portable basketball goals
  • ✓In-ground goals and poles
  • ✓Backboards and rims
  • ✓Water and sand bases
  • ✓Concrete anchor removal (priced by load)
  • ✓Other backyard sports equipment
